_comment: How each team agent is installed into OpenCode. mode: primary agents are chosen as the session agent and are not delegated to; subagent agents are. tier: which model tier the agent takes from the user's model mapping. permission: OpenCode permission rules written into the agent; they replace Claude Code's disallowedTools. The agent-coach rules list a relative and an absolute form because patterns match the path as the tool was given it.

mergeBackstop._comment: Written into every agent unless the install allows autonomous merging. A static deny: it holds even if the plugin fails to load, but cannot read a project's merge_policy, and only matches the command text, so the plugin's merge gate stays the real check.
